title: Dal Segno
description: A music deck for Foundry: play a track's windup once, loop its middle for as long as a fight lasts, and hit its ending when you press the button. Mark sections on a waveform, skip the parts you don't want, seek, change speed, shift pitch and add bass, treble, muffle or reverb, with every player kept at the same point in the track. Includes a tool that shrinks an hour-long video's soundtrack to a small Opus file in your browser. Plays alongside Foundry's own playlists, which it uses as its library.
